title: Flour for the Feast

readiness.math: balancing a weight (older: big scoops weigh two)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: The biggest bake of the year! Every loaf needs just the right flour. Let's weigh it on the honest scales.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Add scoops until the beam hangs level.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Add scoops of flour until the beam hangs level.
steps.hint: Is the beam tipping? Add a scoop, or take one out.

feedback.heavy: Too much! Take a scoop out.
feedback.all_good: Level! Into the bowl it goes.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Do you remember your first bake with me? Look how much you've learned!

journal_line: I weighed flour for the Harvest Supper bread.
unavailable_text: The flour is weighed for today.
